prompt: Produce exactly one concise natural-language caption (a single sentence) that vividly and precisely describes the main subject(s), visible actions, and setting. Use specific action verbs and name any clear maneuvers; indicate movement direction relative to the camera or frame (toward/away/past/left-to-right/right-to-left and upward/downward) and whether motions are simultaneous. Describe body posture with concrete terms (standing, leaning forward/back, seated upright, reclining, crouching, mid-jump, arms outstretched, knees bent) rather than interpretive labels, and report facial expressions or attention only when visually evident, specifying gaze targets (e.g., "eyes looking toward the dog" or "gaze fixed on the camera"). Give precise spatial relationships, scale, and proximity (next to, behind, in front of, atop, touching, a few feet/meters apart, clustered closely, spread apart, in a line) and clarify subjects’ spatial relationship to background elements to convey depth. Note the number and density/flow of people (isolated, a small group, a line, a crowd) and describe visible interaction dynamics only when supported by clear visual cues (hugging, holding hands, reaching, petting). Describe lighting and shadows with observable cues (directional backlight, side light, diffuse/overcast light, strong cast shadows), state where shadows fall (onto ground, building, faces) and approximate shadow direction or length, and include visible surface textures or effects such as wet pavement, puddles, splashes, reflections, or motion blur when present. Keep the caption concrete and image-centered, avoid speculation or subjective judgments unless directly supported by visible evidence, and output exactly one single-sentence caption (no lists, tags, multiple candidates, or metadata).

cases.caption: A young girl with arms outstretched and knees bent is captured mid-air, leaping upward and forward toward a large pile of fallen leaves in front of her, her gaze fixed ahead as she approaches the leaf mound, with a silver vehicle and evergreen tree visible behind her in the background.

Four men are seated around a table in a dimly lit room, with one man in the foreground leaning forward and gesturing with his right hand toward the center of the table while another man across from him looks toward him, and a third man seated behind them gazes toward the right side of the frame, all positioned

A woman in a striped shirt walks toward the camera on a wet cobblestone path, while a group of people sits clustered on benches to her right, and others stroll past in both directions under the dappled shade of leafy trees, with diffuse daylight casting soft shadows onto the glistening pavement.

A jockey in a yellow helmet and striped jacket leans forward, arms gripping the reins, as they ride a powerful brown horse mid-jump over a weathered wooden fence, both bodies arched upward and forward in unison against a backdrop of dense green trees under bright, even daylight.

A young child with blonde hair, seated upright at the edge of a fountain, leans forward with an open-mouthed expression as water sprays upward and past them, their gaze fixed on the cascading streams while sunlight filters through the foliage behind, casting soft shadows onto their face and the wet stone surface.

Two children, a boy crouching and a girl squatting beside him, are clustered closely on the wet sand at the water’s edge, both leaning forward with focused attention on shaping the sand in front of them as gentle waves lap at their feet behind them.

Three men are seated on a rooftop terrace, reclining on cushions and engaging in conversation while a small black-and-white dog stands alert nearby, its head turned toward the right edge of the frame, as shadows from the surrounding buildings stretch across the textured stone walls and the low concrete parapet.

A dense crowd of men in black hats and coats stands clustered closely in front of a metal barricade, some leaning forward while others stand upright, as Palestinian flags wave behind them and a few individuals gesture or hold signs toward the camera, under bright daylight casting sharp shadows onto the pavement.

Two men stand side-by-side in front of vintage cars, one playing an accordion while the other holds a smaller instrument, both facing forward with focused expressions as their shadows stretch across the pavement beneath them.

Two snowshoers, one crouching to adjust gear and the other standing upright beside them, navigate a sunlit, snow-covered forest trail with shadows cast sharply across the ground, their movements simultaneous and focused on the task at hand as they progress forward through the deep powder.

A goalkeeper in red dives leftward toward the ball while a cluster of players in yellow and white jerseys leap and extend arms upward and outward in a simultaneous aerial scramble for the ball, with the ball suspended above them and the crowd blurred in the background under bright stadium lights casting sharp shadows onto the green pitch.

Three individuals in separate wooden boats navigate a murky river, paddling left-to-right with oars angled downward, while one person stands upright in the foreground boat and another leans forward in the middle boat, all moving past a row of elevated stilt houses with visible signage and wooden pilings extending into the water under diffuse daylight
